$description: Design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the design system. Edit values here only -- do not hand-edit the generated src/index.css or src/generated/tokens.ts. The dev server regenerates them on every change (scripts/build-tokens.mjs, wired through vite.config.ts). Colors are authored as hex; the generator converts them to `H S% L%` channels for the web theme and keeps hex for mobile (tokens.ts). Every color role exists in both light and dark.

background.$description: Warm ivory used at the top of Outfit's vertical background.

border.$description: Warm neutral border; the glass treatment uses its own translucent white edge.

primary.$description: Charcoal ink for primary actions and emphasis.

secondary.$description: Warm taupe from the lower end of the app background gradient.

mutedForeground.$description: Slightly deeper than the source swatch so secondary text stays readable on the warm lower background.

accent.$description: Soft gold used for quiet accent surfaces; darker gold details use chart1.

destructive.$description: Muted brick red for destructive actions and validation errors.

background.$description: Warm charcoal from Outfit's original dark palette.

secondary.$description: Warm near-black at the bottom of the dark background gradient.

muted.$description: Toasted brown used for dark icon and ambient surfaces.

destructive.$description: Accessible soft brick red for destructive actions and validation errors on dark surfaces.

sans.$description: Use Satoshi for all interface and body text.

serif.$description: Reserve Melodrama Medium for large editorial headlines.

base.$description: 24px base card radius; pill controls use fully rounded corners.
